diagnostic_map_registration.registration: Independent linear x/y fits from all seven visible eastings and all five northings; numerical centers of PDF text labels, not surveyed grid intersections. WGS84 UTM22S assumed from geographic location and grid magnitudes; visible map crop does not state datum/zone. Diagnostic qualitative alignment only.
diagnostic_map_registration.coordinate_transform: GDAL/OSR EPSG:4326 traditional GIS longitude-latitude axis order to EPSG:32722
diagnostic_map_registration.controls_scope: Map text-label centers are numerical controls for the diagnostic image fit; their residual is not geodetic or shoreline error.
diagnostic_map_registration.map_frame_coverage: All target source vertices fall within the inspected map frame. The map also depicts water outside the source polygon, including upstream detail near Buritama.
